subject: Copywriting
title: Lee Clow: Think Different
description: A fast breakdown of Lee Clow: Think Different for builders.

hook.text: Lee Clow's 1984 Apple commercial aired once during the Super Bowl and never ran again. One showing was enough.

buildup.text: Clow led TBWA\Chiat\Day and became Steve Jobs' creative partner. Together they built Apple's rebellious brand voice.

discovery.text: The 'Think Different' campaign featured Einstein, Lennon, and Gandhi.

twist.text: Apple was nearly bankrupt when 'Think Different' launched.

climax.text: Clow proved that a brand is a story, not a product. His work for Apple is studied in every business school.

punchline.text: One Super Bowl ad, aired once. Changed tech marketing forever.

quiz.question: What was Apple's state when 'Think Different' launched?
